summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of Ciltarasa Phase 1-5 (buyer OTP auth, post-delivery review flow, Shopee-style catalog, seller config pages, discounts). Backend: 19/19 tests passed. Frontend: all major flows verified including onboarding modal, profile dropdown, viral hero, sort options, product detail modal, About section, 6-step order tracking with 'Konfirmasi Penerimaan', review banner, seller sidebar groups (Operasional + Konfigurasi), config pages and product management.

issues: A few Unsplash image URLs in DEFAULT_PRODUCTS occasionally return broken/blank (e.g. risoles photo-1625220194771, cireng photo-1626202373052). Card shows alt text fallback. Consider verifying each image URL or switching to a single reliable food image CDN.
WebSocket reconnect warning shown briefly in console: 'WebSocket is closed before the connection is established.' Functional impact: none — real-time still works after handshake completes.

action_items: Optional: Replace flaky Unsplash photo IDs in DEFAULT_PRODUCTS (risoles, cireng, siomay duplicates) so each product has a stable, distinct food image.
Optional: Suppress or debounce WebSocket reconnect log noise on initial mount.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 829 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold; consider splitting into routers (auth, products, orders, store_config, reviews, discounts, reports) for maintainability.
auth/me uses `token=user.id` directly (no JWT/signature). Acceptable for simulated OTP MVP but document this so it doesn't ship to production.
Phone normalization assumes Indonesian format only; foreign numbers would be silently prefixed with 62. Fine for current scope.
DB drops entire collections on schema bump — fine for dev but must be guarded before any production rollout.
Product create response performs broadcast but doesn't strip _id when first inserted — currently safe because insert_one mutates dict; verified doc.pop('_id', None) is in place. OK.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed product/discount/review/order during pytest. ORD-0004 (Ahmad Fauzi, status=selesai, received=true) preserved as canonical test case for review flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Schema v2.0.2 active with 12 seeded products + 5 sample orders. ORD-0004 is the only seed order with received=true (selesai). The buyer onboarding modal blocks the UI on first visit — testing must click [data-testid="onboarding-guest-btn"] OR complete register/login flow first. Tracking input requires page.type() (not page.fill()) for React onChange. Sidebar tab IDs: dashboard, orders, products, sales, financial, store-profile, store-cerita, categories, delivery, payments, discounts, whatsapp. OTP is always '123456'.
